items.summary: Recommend containment-only execution and no new spend, queue admissions, monetization expansion, or forecasts. Amazon revenue is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; it is not site-attributable. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, and cost-to-learn are unknown because matching-period allocated costs and attributable revenue are unavailable. The 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 AI ledger records $947.40 across 5,289 calls, but it cannot be compared to one revenue day or treated as total fleet cost. Continue only the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation, deployed-work measurement, repair-or-close, security evidence, private launch gates, and parked-site readiness. Minimum financial measurement is a dated ledger matching AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, commitments, and site/content attribution to the same revenue period. Do not infer revenue from clicks, sessions, conversions, impressions, or negative AI-only scorecard margins.

Retain the existing finance reconciliation only. Named Amazon tracking rows are site-mapped, but the provider's aggregate row contains $4.92 commission and cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Cost-to-learn is not calculable: no approved learning-cost denominator or attributable incremental outcome is available, and experiment telemetry shows no completed experiments. Minimum measurement is one approved learning unit, its fully allocated period cost, baseline outcome, post-change outcome, and a predefined success threshold. Preserve unknowns and do not use vanity metrics as financial evidence.
